english: If you resist it, it will only go back to the scholar.
If you wish to protect him- let it in.
Try to resist it.
(Let it in.)
Your mind is a fortress.
The ghostly whispers invade nonetheless.
But they are stopped by the moat- dancing like a crown round your mind.
Until the spirits move over- once again targeting Snurre.
Your mind is a fortress- the gates beaten down by a spiritual invasion.
It floods in. Every crevice filled by ghostly whispers.
Whispers and screams.
And you open the gate.
You stand back, watching the book's energies focus in on the scholar's mind.
His body jolts. His limbs twisting.
<shake>...GAH</shake>!
For about twenty seconds.
Then he stops the erratic movements.
And slumps in his chair.
Gods be damned...
Check if he's breathing.
Mr. Appledent?
(Lean forward to check for a pulse.)
OH WELL.
The halfling moves. His eyes blank - then GLOWING.
THIS WILL HAVE TO DO.
His throat releases deep thrumming vibrations, imitating that of speechcraft.
A ghostly possession.
How quaint.
His mind is invaded by the animated spirit.
Tread carefully.
Oh no.
What's wrong with your voice?
(Wait to see what it does.)
He leans forward in the chair, seemingly looking around- limply, smoothly.
Then the pale eyes of the halfling land on you.
I AM CIVIDIX. YOU HAVE HEARD OF ME, NO?
So it's the- it's the guy.
The guy who wrote that book?
I see. Greetings, Lord Scholar. (Be wary of the possessed halfling.)
(Be ready for anything while breathing heavily.)
YOU ARE NOT A VERY INTELLIGENT MAN, ARE YOU?
That is possible, yes.
There's no good way to answer that, so I am simply going to stand here, like a stoyic man.
Nuh-uh.
A STOYIC?
DO YOU MEAN, STOIC?
Maybe?
JOR BE DAMNED. I AM SUMMONED TO DEAL WITH A RETARD.
That is a mean word, from a different era.
This is a mean man from that exact era.
Get some knowledge out of him, before he moves on for good.
SOME MANNERS. GOOD.
YOUR FOOLISH ATTEMPT AT BREAKING THE SEAL HAS UNLEASHED ME, the halfling limply continues.
He then opens his mouth, a light consuming the space between you.
Oh fuck!
The goblin ducks to the side.
<shake>THERE</shake>.
WE SHALL SPEAK UNINTERRUPTED.
(Grab your head and groan.)
Your vision grows bright.
OH WELL.
THIS WILL HAVE TO DO.
What's going on?
Get out of my head!
Hey. Uh, who are you?
THINK A LITTLE BEFORE YOU SPEAK.
A MAN? OR A SCARED CHILD?
I EXPECTED MORE.
SUCH A DIM-WITTED HUMAN. HOW FAR WE HAVE FALLEN.
What? Who are you?
I AM CIVIDIX.
The guy who wrote that book?
I see. Greetings, Lord Scholar. (Be wary of this mental meeting.)
What is it you want? Why have you entered my mind?
YOU ARE NOT A VERY INTELLIGENT MAN, ARE YOU?
That is possible, yes.
There's no good way to answer that, so I am simply going to stand here, like a stoyic man.
Nuh-uh.
A STOYIC?
DO YOU MEAN, STOIC?
Yes.
Maybe?
JOR BE DAMNED. I AM SUMMONED TO DEAL WITH A RETARD.
And stop saying these genuinely mentally retardant things.
SOME MANNERS. GOOD.
I HAVE NOT DONE ANYTHING.
NONETHELESS, THIS IS AN IMPROVEMENT OVER BEING BROUGHT BACK AS A TOOL FOR THAT MISBRED MUTANT.
TELL ME. WHAT DO YOU WISH TO GAIN FROM MYSELF; HERE IN THIS NEAR CORPOREAL FORM?
OR IS IT THIS HALF-LING WHOSE FOOLISH AMBITIONS YOU SHALL FULFILL?
I don't give a shit about you. I just helped Snurre find that book.
Snurre Appledent is a great scholar. He will continue your work.
I wish to know your secrets, Lord Cividix.
A MERCENARY, THEN. HOW DRAB.
THIS LOWER BEING WILL NOT DO ANYTHING BEYOND DIGGING A HOLE IN THE GROUND.
ANYTHING BEYOND IS BUT A RABBIT DREAMING OF JUMPING TO THE MOON.
AMBITION OF MAN HAS NOT ALL DIED THEN.
YOU MAY ASK WHATEVER QUESTIONS YOU HAVE - ONLY FOR THE ESOTERIC SHACKLES BOUND AROUND MY SOUL I SHALL ANSWER.
Who was that 'mutant' you mentioned?
Snurre wanted to ask about the Anima/Animus...
I'm a cleric. Do you have some insight about the gods?
I'm a wizard. Do you have any lost knowledge about String research?
I'm a rogue. How do I make money?
Tell me about this psychoanalysis thing.
Tell me about yourself.
Is your soul in all copies of this 6th Edition book?
M-I have nothing more to ask.
A DAMNED HAGGINSHAGS. ONE CRAWLING AROUND THE HOLES OF THIS HORRID PLACE.
I HAD HOPED FOR THEM ALL TO HAVE FALLEN - ALAS, SOME HAVE CLEARLY CLUNG TO A TYPE OF DISGUSTING EXISTENCE.
Unlike you, who is clinging on to a completely regular existence.
An Arcanist?
I see.
MY GHOSTLY FORM IS NOTHING BUT A TEMPORARY MEASURE, I ASSURE YOU.
A TRUE ONE, YES. DESPITE THIS ONE BEING, WHAT I WOULD CONSIDER, A DAMNED IDIOT.
HIMVRÂK HAGGINSHAGS IS A CRAZED ABOMINATION. HE WILL NEVER RETURN TO A SANE STATE, NO MATTER HIS LOFTY AMBITIONS.
AND THAT IDIOTIC GREETING OF HIS, IT HAS BURNED A HOLE INTO MY MIND I WILL NEVER BE ABLE TO REPAIR.
IF YOU EVER SEE HIM, KILL HIM. IT WOULD BE A MERCY UPON HIS ANCIENT SOUL.
I'm looking forward to meeting him some day.
I'll kill him for sure. Abominations need to be destroyed in Norvik.
Greeting? What greeting?
DO NOT. OR YOU TOO WILL LOSE A PART OF YOUR SANITY.
GOOD. I APPROVE.
THAT INBRED IDIOT ALWAYS SAID THE SAME PHRASE WHENEVER HE OPENED MY BOOK.
What was it?
'AHOY-HOY'.
IDIOTIC. NEVER ASK ME TO UTTER IT AGAIN.
YES, THAT IS WHY MOST WISH TO GATHER THE 6TH EDITION.
THE DOZEN COPIES I CRAFTED EACH CONTAIN A DIFFERENT FOREWORD, EACH A FRAGMENT OF MY KNOWLEDGE.
MY DECADES OF RESEARCH.
I COULD NOT PUBLISH MOST OF IT, AS IT USED ILLEGAL DATA GATHERED DURING VARIOUS ARCANIST EXPERIMENTS.
What did you find?
THE ANIMA AND ANIMUS ARE INCOMPLETE IDEAS.
THEY ARE BUT A SHADE OF A GREATER COLOR, A SWATCH STANDING MIDST A PALETTE OF THE MIND.
THROUGH MENTAL TRIBULATIONS AND INTENSE PHYSICAL EXERTION, I MANAGED TO EXTRACT A DEEPER UNDERSTANDING - A CATEGORIZATION - OF THE MIND.
THERE IS OVERLAP TO GENERAL PERSONALITY RESEARCH, HOWEVER IT DOES NOT MATCH PERFECTLY, AS ALL CREATURES SEEM TO EXHIBIT THESE CATEGORIES IN DIFFERENT FORMS.
SIX CATEGORIES TO BE PRECISE.
Six?
THEY ARE NOT PROMINENT IN THE THOUGHTS OF MOST. THEY ARE NOT EASILY PINNED DOWN. NOR ARE THEY PRACTICAL DUE TO THEIR CHANGING NATURE.
HOWEVER, THERE ARE SIX SHADES OF THE PSYCHE WHICH CAN BE PRACTICALLY EXPLORED AND EXAMINED- EACH ON A SPECTRUM OF ITS OWN.
Oh.
I HAVE DISTILLED THEM INTO THE FOLLOWING TERMS.
FORCE.
AGILITY.
BODY.
INTELLECT.
AWARENESS.
PRESENCE.
He's close.
EACH CREATURE HAS VARIOUS ASPECTS IMPRINTED ONTO THESE SIX. FOR EXAMPLE, THE MASCULINE IS MOST OFTEN FOUND WITHIN THE FORCE. THOUGH SOME CAN SEE IT MORE WITHIN THE INTELLECT OR PRESENCE.
WHILE THE FEMININE IS MOST OFTEN FOUND WITHIN THE BODY OR AWARENESS.
THERE IS MUCH MORE TO BE DISCOVERED HERE. I WAS IN THE MIDDLE OF MY LATEST COMPILATION WHEN DISASTER STRUCK.
ONCE I RETURN, THE WORK SHALL CONTINUE.
GODS ARE BUT CHOSEN OF THE OUTSIDERS.
I ONCE INTERVIEWED A GOD DURING THE WAR. A FELLOW WITH LIGHT FEATURES, HIS ORIGIN TRACING BACK TO VOURGENI FARMERS.

HE WAS TAKEN TO THAZEN AS A GUEST, SUCCESSFULLY SIGNING A PEACE BETWEEN HIS INSIGNIFICANT PEOPLE AND OUR EMPIRE. NOT AN IDIOT, DESPITE HIS POOR BREEDING. IT MUST HAVE BEEN THE HUMAN BLOOD IN THAT GIANT'S VEINS.
HE EXPLAINED TO ME THE FUNCTIONS OF DIVINITY, AS HE AND OTHER WALKING GODS EXPERIENCED IT: A VIEW OF STRINGS.
FUTURES. THAT OF CHANCE AND FATE.

THIS CORROBORATES THE COMMON UNDERSTANDING OF JOR'S STRINGS AS CHRONOLOGICALLY BOUND- AND IT APPEARS WALKING GODS CARRY AN ABILITY TO PEER, THROUGH NEAR AUTONOMOUS DIVINATION, INTO THE FRAYS THEMSELVES.
WHICH EXPLAINS THEIR RISE DURING THE DIVINE ERA. WHILE SIMULTANEOUSLY MAKING THEIR FALL DURING OUR ERA ALL THE MORE EMBARRASSING.
I don't understand. They can see Strings?
Frays?
Please elaborate.
NOT ONLY. THEY SEE STRINGS THROUGH TIME.
YES. THE MANY WAYS OUR PATHS CAN TREAD.
IF YOU CANNOT UNDERSTAND MY VERY BASIC EXPLANATION, THERE IS NO HOPE FOR YOU.
IN ANY CASE, GODS ARE BUT A RELIC OF A BYGONE ERA.
YOU NEED NOT THINK OF THEM ANY LONGER. I SUGGEST LEAVING WHATEVER DIVINE PATH YOU ARE ON THE SAME MOMENT THE CHANNELING OF THOSE POWERS STOP.
BELIEF HAS NO POWER IN JOR'S REALM. NOT IN THIS ERA OF CROWDS.
I DO NOT RESEARCH THE ESOTERIC.
WHAT I CAN TELL YOU IS ONLY THE COMMON KNOWLEDGE OF THE ARCANISTS.
MAGIC IS TRUE POWER. STRINGS ARE CHRONOLOGICAL.
AND THE PURPOSE OF MAN IS TO RULE OVER LESSER RACES.
But most humans died in the Coast War? Caused by the Arcanists?
Chronological, huh.
NINETY PERCENT, YES.
HOWEVER, IT IS OBVIOUS THE CAUSE FOR THE WAR IS BUT THE IDIOCY OF THOSE SAME LESSER RACES.
MAN DID NOT START THE WAR. HAD THE ESOTERIC NOT FORSAKEN THE GREAT HOUSES, IT WOULD NOT HAVE BECOME SUCH A DRAWN OUT ORDEAL.

HAD THE WORLD NOT CURSED OUR KIN, WE WOULD TODAY BE RULED BY THE THAZEN ELITE, A WISE, RIGHTEOUS, MASCULINE, MERITO-TECHNO-MAGO-CRATIC UNITY. THE WORLD WOULD BE COMPLETE. INSTEAD OF THIS CHAOTIC AND FEMININE MADNESS YOU HAVE BUILT FOR YOURSELVES.
Whoa. Why feminine? You don't like women?
That sounds awesome.
I feel like you're just ranting at this point.
I DO NOT FEEL THE NEED TO GO INTO ANY SORT OF DEEP JUDGEMENT UPON THE BROAD STROKES OF THIS TEMPORARY POWER STRUCTURE YOU LIVE IN.
BUT I WILL SUGGEST YOU GET CONTROL OF THE ANIMA.
IT DOES NOTHING BUT BREED CONTEMPT WHEN LEFT IN CHARGE.
A GLIMPSE INTO A BETTER WORLD AND YOUR MIND IS LEFT AWESTRUCK.
TYPICAL.
YOU MAY STOP YOUR INQUIRY AT ANY TIME, YOU MAN OF LITTLE MANHOOD.
BASIC KNOWLEDGE.
IN A WORLD RULED BY FREESTRIDER IDEALS, THE PRIMARY TOOLS OF VICTORY ARE POPULISM, LOBBYISM, AND DIVERSITY.
What?
POPULISM: SEEK THE FAVOR OF THE CROWD, IN PURE PATHOS. IF REALITY GETS IN YOUR WAY, REWRITE FACTS THROUGH THE TOOLS OF THE ERA.
LOBBYISM: USE WEALTH TO GENERATE POLITICAL POWER, TO GENERATE MORE WEALTH. THIS IS A DIFFICULT GAME, ONE YOU MUST MASTER TO WIN IN DEMOCRACY AND LIBERTY.

DIVERSITY: BREAK THE SPIRIT OF THE POPULACE THROUGH LACK OF UNITY OF THOUGHT. THE GUSHING WOUNDS OF THE LOWER CLASSES CANNOT COAGULATE WITHOUT A SOLID BASE. LEAVE THEM DISTRUSTING OF EACH OTHER - THEN SIMPLY DIVIDE AND CONQUER AS ANY CLASSICAL EMPEROR.
But how does that make me money?
I think I understand. I need to win the game.
Right. Thanks.
IN VICTORY AGAINST THEIR IDIOTIC SYSTEM, YOU CAN SHAPE IT IN ANY WAY YOU WANT.
THEIR FILTHY GAME, YES.
YOU SEE NOW WHY THEY WILL NEVER BE ABLE TO SUSTAIN THEMSELVES.
A LIBERAL DEMOCRACY WILL ALWAYS DECAY IN TIME, AS LONG AS THEY DO NOT PERFORM THREE COUNTER-ACTS.
FIRST, KILL THEIR CULTURAL LIBERTY - TO UNITE THE LOWER CLASSES.
SECOND, KILL THEIR EFFECTIVE CAPITAL - TO DESTROY THE RISE OF OLIGARCHY.
AND FINALLY, KILL THEIR DEMOCRACY - IN TIMES WHEN REALITY HOLDS NO SWAY OVER THE AVERAGE CITIZEN.
SORCERERS WITH A SENSE FOR RHYTHM.
NOTHING MORE.
IT IS NOT.
YET IF YOU ENJOY CALLING YOURSELF UNCIVILIZED, THEN I HAVE NOTHING BUT CONDEMNATION FOR YOU.
THEY ARE TO BE WIELDED. TO BE TAMED.
THE DRUIDIC CALLING IS A FOOL'S HOPE. STORMS DO NOT OBEY MEN WITHOUT THE POWER OF ARCANIST WRANGLEMENT.
DO NOT BE SO SWAYED BY THEIR HIPPY BULLSHIT.
AT FIRST IT WAS A FOLLY.
MY SANITORIUM HAD MANY EXPERIMENTS RUNNING- SOME OF WHICH INVOLVED ESOTERIC HYPNOSIS.
HOWEVER, THE DATA UNCOVERED A CLEAR CORRELATION IN PATIENT HEALTH WHEN FORCED TO SPEAK ABOUT TRAUMA IN CLINICAL SETTINGS.
THE ART OF SPEECHCRAFT COULD LESSEN EFFECTS OF MENTAL WOUNDS.
Could you psychoanalyse me?
NO.
I DO NOT BOTHER HANDLING PATIENTS.
THERE IS NOTHING TO BE GAINED IN PERFORMING SUCH DEGRADING ACTS MYSELF.
But how can you deduce your theories if you don't even interact with the people you write about?
SUCH SIMPLE WORK IS BENEATH ME. I DO NOT COMPILE DATA, I DEBATE AND COMPARE.
Then who does?
IT DOES NOT MATTER. BUT IF YOU MUST KNOW: MY SERVANT'S NAME WAS MUNDUS GAIY.
A HARD WORKER, DESPITE HIS HALFLING BREED.
HIS INANE MUMBLINGS ON DREAMS AND DESIRES WAS DIFFICULT TO COMPILE, HOWEVER, IN THE END I MANAGED TO REFINE THEM INTO REAL SCIENCE.
I WILL KEEP IT SHORT.
I AM THE OFFSPRING OF THAZEN NOBILITY. WHILE OUR STATURE FELL ALONG WITH OUR CITY, I PIVOTED MY EDUCATION AND SUPERIOR BREEDING TO CRAFT POWER DURING THE REVOLUTION.
IT WAS EASY.
THE RABBLE ARE MINDLESS AND CRAVE ETIQUETTE.
You're quite the Arcanist, aren't you?
Look at you now. A spirit in a book.
Uh-huh. And how'd you end up like this?
I AM NO ARCANIST.
I AM SIMPLY THE RESULT OF NOBILITY HAVING TO CONTEND IN AN AGE OF CHAOS.
I GLADLY REMAIN AS AN APPARITION, IF IT MEANS NOT HAVING TO SHARE EARTHEN GROUND WITH MONGRELS AND PEASANT.
THE SECOND WAVE. WHEN THE FREESTRIDERS GREW BOLD ENOUGH TO RILE THEIR RAVING MUTTS INTO BEHEADING ALL BUT THE PUREST OF THEIR KIN - A PURITY ONLY PROVEN BY LOYALTY TO THEIR ETHEREAL IDEALS.
IDEALS CROWNED IN GOLD AND COPPER.
BEFORE I COULD ESCAPE THAT WRETCHED RUIN OF A CITY, I WAS THROWN IN A DUNGEON. THEN, WEEKS LATER, THEY BEHEADED ME IN VIEW OF THE POPULACE. NO TRIAL. NO DIGNITY.
EVEN THE MOST BASED OF MONARCHS - EVEN THE SHADOW LORD HIMSELF - WOULD NOT BEHAVE SO BARBARIC TOWARDS EVEN THEIR GREATEST RIVALS.
IT IS A SIGN OF THE TIMES: THE LACK OF RESPECT FOR ANYTHING BEYOND THE OH SO EASILY SWAYED CROWD.
Why did you stay long enough to be captured?
You really messed up, huh?
So you didn't play the game of crowds.
Revenge?
I HAD MY OWN OPERATIONS IN PLACE.
THE ONE MISTAKE I MADE WAS PLACING FAITH IN THOSE BELOW ME.
I DID.
FOR MANY YEARS. NEWSPAPERS. BRIBES. CALCULATED RHETORIC.
HAD MY SERVANTS ACTED FASTER, HAD THEY NOT FAILED SO THOROUGHLY, IT WOULD NOT BE MY HEAD DECORATING THE SQUARE.
IT WOULD HAVE BEEN MOONWATCH. THAT FILTHY YMIAN.
ALAS, IN TIME I WILL HAVE MY REVENGE.
NOTHING YOU NEED CONCERN YOURSELF WITH, YOU MAN OF SMALL STATURE.
YOU WILL KNOW IN TIME. THEY ALL WILL.
YES.
FRAGMENTS OF THE WHOLE.
A NECROTIC SPELL, NOT UNLIKE THAT OF LICHDOM, WAS UNDERTAKEN.
IF YOU WISH TO LEARN MORE, YOU WILL HAVE TO SURVIVE THIS NEXT ERA.
FOR MY RETURN WILL BE MAGNIFICENT.
You need any help with that?
What if I destroy this book?
THAT WILL DO NOTHING.
YOU DO WITH IT AS YOU PLEASE.
IN FACT, IF YOU DO, I WILL BE HAPPY TO NEVER HAVE TO ANSWER YOUR INQUIRIES AGAIN.
THEN I WILL GLADLY END THIS INANE CONVERSATION.
I SUGGEST NOT SUMMONING ME AGAIN UNTIL YOU HAVE MORE USEFUL QUESTIONS. OR I WILL DESTROY WHATEVER VESSEL IS NEAR.
BUT FOR NOW, YOU HAVE AT THE VERY LEAST SHOWN TO BE LESS OF AN ANNOYANCE THAN THAT DAMNED HAGGINSHAGS.
IN RETURN, I SHALL LEAVE THIS PLANE ONCE MORE - WITHOUT RIPPING YOUR MIND TO SHREDS.
(Let him leave your mind.)
A deep and open vacuum is left within your mind as the presence slips out.
As vision returns to your eyes, you see a rough halfling looking down on you.
Next to him, your companion poking at you with his foot.
I see movement.
Marvelous! Simply, marvelous, my dear Cleric!
You appeared to have been in contact with the spirit of Cividix himself! I've written down your conversation here.
W-what? (Get up.)
You've been out for a few minutes. Talking to yourself.
Didn't seem like too much of a danger though. Mostly just some concerning rhetoric.
And I'm no expert, but you should be careful. Possessions, from what I know, they can have some long-term effects.
The light emanating from Snurre's mouth fades as the final statement erupts.
IN RETURN, I SHALL LEAVE THIS PLANE ONCE MORE - WITHOUT RIPPING THIS HALFLING'S MIND TO SHREDS.
Oh shit, he's talking again?
NOR THAT OF YOUR COWERING GOBLINOID SERVANT.
Hey now.
(Just watch.)
The light disappears entirely, and in an instant the limp movements of Snurre turns into a jolt- a gasp of air.
Ah, fucking hells...
Life is pain.
Then he perks up.
Cividix.
The halfling, sweating and convulsing, immediately grabs a quill and paper.
I must write this down! That conversation was EXTRAORDINARY!
You remember it?
Are you okay, Appledent?
Of course! Or luckily, I suppose.
Yes, yes. More importantly is this information!
Good to see he's himself again.
Snell leans in and says, "Might be some long-term effects, just going from what little I know about possessions. But yeah. Should be cool."
There is so much to learn from this absolute piece of shit!
Did you manage to write down the foreword?
And the rest?
M-"Why did we just accidentally summon the spirit of this dead scholar?"
I did. It's in perfect condition.
The halfling begins to grasp for paper, more and more paper from his desk.
Yes. VERY interesting.
He looks around for a pencil.
He looks over his notes.
Snurre hands over the gem-encrusted tome, its latch firmly re-sealed.
It appears to be some kind of necrotic container. A phylactery of sorts, perhaps?
But in a literal sense, that does not make sense. Rather, my guess is Cividix bound his spirit to all these magical 6th Editions, making sure to spread them out across collections in the world.
For what purpose? Most likely to bring himself back at some point. How? Who knows!
But that book is now yours. Considering the danger involved, I would suggest not opening it again, at least not without a team of backup exorcists.
You don't want to have another chat with the old guy?
What are you going to do with this information?
I'd rather not.
I'm much more interested in finding out more about this Gaiy fellow.
Good question.
First off, I want to find out more about this Gaiy fellow.
Arcanists are well known for appropriating the work of other, lesser, folk, and considering what we heard here today, I wish to delve more properly into all of this.
Snurre turns away from the mess on his desk to face you with a confident smile, and sweaty brow.
This has been a significant step in the right direction.
Thank you, Cleric.
You're welcome.
Hey, I got a magic book out of it. A magic book with a ghost in it.
I'll let you know if I find out anything else.
I'm just glad no one got hurt. Physically.
That I am!
Yes you did!
Just try to be careful with it. Or do whatever, I'm not your mother.
And I thank you for that as well!
As - I think the kids say this these days - they say: always lucky, never punished!
And we shall talk more about this - far more - in the future. That I promise.
Yeah. Wasn't the most fun experience to witness either.
Until the tea shop is dealt with- please don't open that book again.
I have some more questions first.
(Nod, then leave Snurre to his work.)
No? Of course not. I had some biased opinions about Arcanists before today. Now I'm solidified in my position: fuck those guys.
Yeah. Fuck 'em!
They're probably not all so bad. Maybe this guy was just an asshole in general.
Don't say that about my people, Snell.
Something about being able to read history books makes me beg to differ.
I just can't help it. Ghost bigots just bring it out of me.
He looks very tired.
Snurre, meanwhile, is already deep in writing.
Yes! Ahoy-hoy, and so... so on.
Old Master was very special person, Meek realize.
Meek hopes new master does not have to meet Old Master.
Meek think that would end bad...
Snurre glances up from his notes to see your mimic-scarf whispering in your ear.
Mimic as clothing? he mutters and blows out some air. "That's my kind of degeneracy. Good choice in familiar, Cleric."
Then he returns to his work.
He half-glances at you whilst continuing to scribble.
Of course! Go ahead.
Oh, horrific.
He gestures wildly towards the rocky wall. "Shit started shaking. It was as if the red rock of Tolstad itself was cracking."
For half a second or so.
So you were down here when it happened.
Did you go check it out?
You hear anything about it? Rumors?
What do you think happened?
I think I was asleep. But the sound awoke me.
Someone told me later what it was like.
I have work to do here.
You should not believe rumors, Cleric.
But yes, I did hear some nasty stuff. Some people seem to think the owner did it himself, since he is missing.
Some others think the city did it, since they printed a clear lie in the post.
I've also heard people say the Azgalists are responsible, since it was their hideout.
Or that the Freestriders did it, for the same reason. Blowing up Azgalist opposition, and so on.
It's all bullshit, of course. Don't believe rumors.
He shrugs, violently.
I am a filthy Azgalist.
Oh. Why?
Why call it filthy?
Good choice.
Terrible choice.
Pragmatic dogma.
Have you ever seen a clean Azgalist?
Ho, ho!
He laughs at his own joke.
'Joke.'
It is an acceptable choice.
Yes, I feel the same.
The green banner is flown in a strange context here in this republican wet dream of ours.
Azgalism is supposed to be about abolishing the entire structure of hierarchy.
That history is driven by economic struggles - specifically the clash between classes.
Azgal's end goal is a classless, stateless society where everyone's equal.
But looking at the Norvikian Azgalists, it's clear to me they long ago let this goal slip past.
Look at them!
They are shaking hands with the establishment. 'Trying to find a peaceful solution' they say.
You want violent revolution?
They are simply becoming part of the establishment.
Peace is good.
We need violent revolution.
He frowns.
True. A compromise with capitalism will always be all-consuming.
Peace is good, he repeats, tasting the words.
It is. It is good.
Look, the hairy halfling mutters.
Genuine change - true change - needs a truly revolutionary break with the existing order. There is no doubt about that.
Incremental reforms - small changes - within the capitalist system will always fail to address its fundamental contradictions and injustices.
My time in Reeds made that clear to me.
But always be wary of simplistic utopian visions. It is a path covered in corpses that leads such blind idealism.
So I will vote for this social democratic compromise.
This handshake with capital.
Then I'll go home and piss myself and die. Dreaming the next generation will have answers I do not.
A compromise is good enough for now.
I hope the next generation votes for violent revolution.
Any Azgalism is too much Azgalism. You should all be run out of the city.
I, on the other hand, am not an Azgalist.
You'd think I agreed. Part of me does.
But I do truly hate this idea of tipping the hat to these- these truly fascist regimes.
He grumbles.

Do not be too eager to deal out death in judgment. Not because these- these truly fascist regimes do not warrant death. But because whatever force would be strong enough to dismantle them would be so powerful that we could never trust them to create a perfect realm without oppression.
Not even Azgal could do that.
Yes, and back into the hole in the ground.
Me, I suppose, I'd be forced back into my homeland in the rigid ice sheet surrounding Tipberry.
Lucky bastard.
And yes, even the Revolutionary Freestriders are fascists, in a deep sense.
How do you think they got their start? Through the coin of those who profited in the great suffering of Old Diminor. In the Coast War. In grinding the flesh of humanity.
Freestriderism is filthy opportunism, not republicanism. They are just Arcanist regimes with a painted mask and slightly less horrific esoterical power in hand. Slightly.
So what? We don't even try to bring about Azgal's dream?
Freestriders are more than that. They're the ones who got this election started.
Freestriders are truly terrifying.
I don't know. I am an idiot. You figure it out.
They make elections happen when they are able to win them.
That is both opportunism and imperialism at its worst.
Agreed.
With a deep groan he starts rubbing his hairy face.
Workers' unite, and unionization, and 'Guild Power'... it is all well and good. Until it gets too loud.

Make a bit too much noise, and the true powers quickly and efficiently drop this illusionary mask, facade. The esoteric spell that tricks us into thinking they care. Or that they are in any way folkarian.
Eh. So what about you, Cleric?
Tell me. If not Azgalist, what are you voting?
You're voting Azgalist, I presume?
I'm voting for the Party of Norvik.
I'm voting for the Freestriders.
I'm voting for the new god-king wizard emperor of Norvik.
I really want to vote Agrarian. But...
Voting? (Laugh.) "My good gnome, I am entirely apolitical."
He shakes his head, looking confused. "Are you?!"
Okay. Why not?
Most Azgalists are a bit confused. You'll fit right in.
Terrible to hear. But why not, right?
He laughs. "Fucking fascist!"
But good! Be honorable and stand by your city and your dead god.
And don't get upset when they sell out to the Freestriders afterwards.
His face darkens.
And you are aware of what evil you are tampering with?
Yes. I like evil.
They're not evil.
(Gasp.) "What? No, I had no idea!"
Well. You won't be alone on this Coast.
Stay ignorant, then.
For what is evil, but the seeking of one's own profit over the health of the realm?
He gasps as well. "My goodness! How could you not?!"
He's feigning it.
Capitalism is good. It brings prosperity. It's proven.
I'm not arguing with you.
True, he says and nods.
No comeback?
